question: Should OpenClaw pursue this enterprise control-plane direction, and which small set of authority and resource-model contracts should be accepted for RFC work first?
rationale: The PR proposes permanent multi-tenant, IAM, gateway, and provider-boundary choices; implementation quality cannot determine whether those are the product boundaries OpenClaw should adopt.

options.title: Sponsor and split the direction
options.body: Accept the enterprise-platform exploration in principle, then ask for a short direction RFC followed by separate RFCs with clear decision boundaries.

options.title: Narrow to Kubernetes-native extension points
options.body: Ask for a revised proposal centered on CRDs, operators, and native platform primitives, with custom abstractions only where their limits are demonstrated.

options.title: Decline or defer the direction
options.body: Do not take on an enterprise control-plane program now and leave the current draft unmerged until priorities change.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and split the direction
recommendation.body: Accept the enterprise-platform exploration in principle, then ask for a short direction RFC followed by separate RFCs with clear decision boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal author is best positioned to narrow the draft after maintainers state the product direction.
